code_hints: Immediately after navigation, try to click the OneTrust cookie button if present: selector '#onetrust-accept-btn-handler' with a short timeout (e.g., 2-3s). Ignore errors if not found.

If a locale/country modal appears, attempt to close/confirm using any of: text buttons matching 'Continue', 'United Kingdom', 'Stay on this site', or a close 'X' button. Use a short best-effort pass and ignore if not found.
Ensure you are on a PLP: wait for any of selectors: 'main [data-testid*="product-grid"]', 'main .product-grid', 'main ul.products' and at least 6 product cards before extracting.
Extract PDP links from product cards using the first matching link under each card that contains '/en-gb/' in href.
On PDP, wait for 'h1' title and a price selector from the provided list before reading textContent.
If at any point you are redirected to a different locale (href contains '/en-..../'), rewrite to '/en-gb/' and reload.
Use a realistic desktop UA and small random delays between actions to reduce anti-bot friction.
rationale: The failure occurred because the crawler landed on the homepage, which has no PLP tiles and may show cookie/locale overlays. Prioritizing configuration, we set a stable category PLP start URL under en-gb to guarantee product tiles. We add URL normalization to keep locale anchored to en-gb and avoid corporate domains. Minimal, robust selectors target generic product grids and price/title elements commonly used on Moncler/SFCC builds. Code hints cover accepting OneTrust cookies and dismissing locale modals that can block rendering and extraction.
